sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the 
equipment major maintenance I2, which must be performed on annual bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block

The technical specifications of the rotary screw 
air compressor model 13.9 H.H-S.S.R 2000, 1480rpm, single stage, 8 bar, 3 phase, 380 
volt, 117.9 kw, 50 Hz

The first draft initiated by 
eng. Osman Abdel Dayem Nagar, tested by eng. Ahmed Saber Gabr at 18 July 
2004, accepted by eng. Ahmad Saber Gabr Pre- general director of Turbines 
maintenance, and approved by eng Abdel Karem Abu Zied Ismaiel; Head Sector of High 
Dam Hydraulic Power Station, Hyd.EPCo.,

This document certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem 
MPIS Hyd.EPCo. Coordinator.
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, safety glass ... etc
Switch off AC power supply.
Close air outlet valve.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment
Set of wrenches and screwdrivers.
Wiping material and cleaning liquid.
Coolant - lubricant oil.
Spare parts.

items: Set of wrenches and screwdrivers.
Wiping material and cleaning liquid.
Coolant - lubricant oil.
Spare parts.

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Drain the coolant lubricant oil soon after the 
compressor shut down.
Replace the air intake filter and the oil filter.

Check and clean coolant-lubricant separator element and replace if 
necessary.
Check & clean all bearings and replace if necessary.
Check & clean the condensate valve and replace if necessary.
Check all the control valves.
Change the gaskets if necessary.
Check & review cooling fan.
Clean all parts of the compressor.
Close all drain valves & refill the compressor with fresh coolant.
Start the compressor & run it for a short time.

Shut the compressor down & check the coolant level in the receiver 
and adjust the coolant level.
Check the pressure and the temperature gauges.
